coverage.threshold_rule: At least 3 distinct dated comparable observations spanning at least 90 days from at least 2 independent origins, or a verified continuous price series covering at least 90 days.

limitations: All six web_fetch attempts failed. Every candidate page (PriceMe, PB Tech, Noel Leeming) returned an access error, and the fetch budget of 3 was spent, so no price could be verified from a fetched page. No observations or current alternatives are submitted.
Candidate sources ChoiceCheapies (cheapies.nz), BetaDeals and Cheapest NZ were not searched within the limited search budget.

Previous Black Friday (2025-11-28) price for the exact MTJV3ZA/A USB-C variant could not be established from a verified page. The only related lead is a PB Tech snippet from search results, which is unverified.

The off-season window (2025-11-29 to 2026-11-26) has no verified dated price. Snippet leads from PriceMe and Mwave show a $353.05 entry dated 01 Dec 2025 and a 25 Dec 2025 entry, but these are unverified.

Search snippets show conflicting current prices across retailers (about NZD 369 to 479 for the USB-C variant), with no date-stamped history confirming which is current. Some listings may be the 2022 Lightning-case model or the 2023 USB-C model, so product matching is uncertain.
PriceSpy's product page for the 2023 USB-C variant says there is no price history data, and no continuous price-history series with start and end dates was found for NZ.
